boundaries: SUBSCRIBED to NONE or IGNORED commits the final local desired state with one generation-aware MoviePilot DELETE operation and Outbox event in the same transaction
PENDING_RELEASE remains the existing not-yet-released business state and is never reused as a provider-operation pending marker
provider rejection, cancellation, unknown, or indeterminate outcomes remain durable operation facts and do not rewrite the committed local desired state
subscription_sources_json remains opaque JSON and preserves manual and user_request source objects
batch delete never bypasses a subscribed provider deletion and never creates or releases quota
active Cleanup or Resubscribe work returns an intentional 409 compatibility correction instead of deleting an owned item
real MoviePilot, Emby, HDHive, shared pool, Telegram, production database, and credentials are excluded from local verification
